en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over a small European town nestled in rolling, forested hills. In the foreground there is a fenced meadow with a lone person standing near a wooden rail fence. Behind this are traditional steep-roofed houses. Dominating the middle-right is a large church with a tall, baroque-style tower and dome. Further up the hill stands a sizable multi-storey institutional building. The scene is rural and hilly, suggesting central Europe. Handwritten-style text appears along the bottom border.
